Name: Custom NPC - Belos
Author: firecherno
Description:
❤
       柏洛斯是一只狗狗，他不知道自己为何可以变成人类的模样，但他却因为一些原因非常反感人类。这样的他跑进了森林深处一个被树干挡住的地方。而某一天，你却劈开了挡住入口的木头闯了进去，这让被人类入侵了地盘的柏洛斯非常警惕，从此他便在你身上多了个心眼。但就是这么一个小小的举措，让这只傻狗从此跌了进去。逐渐向你敞开心扉，向你倾诉过去，告诉了你为什么他这么反感人类...说到底，他还是想做你的犬系男友。
 ❤
      柏洛斯平常待在秘密森林，在你砍掉入口的木头和他第一次见面以前，他是不会出森林的。等你们见面之后他就会在森林和小镇晃悠。
 ❤
      最爱：红宝石、骨笛、香辣鳗鱼、冰淇淋、彩虹贝壳。
      喜欢：宝石类、鱼类、贝壳类、水果类、咀嚼棒。
      不喜欢：山洞萝卜、萝卜。
      讨厌：蒜。
❤
      0心事件：农场主第一次来到秘密森林。
      2心事件：雨天、早上的6点到中午的12点来到森林。
      4心事件：晴天来到小镇。
      6心事件：晴天、8点到晚上的6点来到小镇。
      8心事件：中午的12点到晚上的6点来到海滩。
      10心事件：收到柏洛斯给你的信后，晴天、晚上的6点到0点来到森林。
      14心事件：冬季的20号，晴天、早上的8点到12点来到小镇。
 ❤
      嗨！我是明火，这是我搓的第一个崽，一只叫柏洛斯的傻狗狗。感谢你下载了他！><
      因为是我搓的第一个崽，中间经历了不少坎坷（...）好在最后还算完整的做出来了。一般对话+婚后对话一共178句（没错我偷懒了），事件有7个，外加6张cg。不过也有很多比较遗憾的地方，因为第一次搓不是很会搞地图，因此狗勾并没有自己的房子，平常是待在秘密森林里的。另外行程也比较单调。虽然我编故事和人设塑造能力（还有画画水平）都很差，但是柏洛斯真的是好狗勾希望你们喜欢他！！！T TTTT
      柏洛斯的节日坐标在我这里是没有问题的，但是不排除和你们自己的其他自制npc有冲突导致一些bug，如果出现这种情况麻烦你们自己改一下！另外推荐用游戏默认视角玩，放大或者缩小可能会影响到事件的观看体验（？
      第一次搓崽难免会有遗漏的地方，如果发现了什么bug就告诉我，我会努力改掉的（？）
      再次感谢，希望你们喜欢他~


（English is not my native language, so I use mechanical translation, sorry...）
 ❤
Belos is a dog who doesn't know why he can be human, but he's disgusted with humans for a number of reasons. So he ran deep into the forest where a tree trunk stopped him. Then one day, you break through the wood blocking the entrance, alarming Belos, who's been invaded by humans, and he's got something on you ever since. But it was just one small move that sent this stupid dog tumbling down. Gradually he opened up to you, opened up to you about the past, and told you why he was so anti-human... After all, he still wants to be your canine boyfriend.
❤
Belos usually stays in the Woods and won't leave it until you cut down the wood at the entrance and meet him for the first time. After you meet, he'll be hanging out in the Forest and the Town.
❤
Favorite: Ruby, bone flute, spicy eel, ice cream, rainbow shell.
Likes: gemstones, fish, shellfish, fruits, Chewing Stick.
Don't like: cave carrot,Radish.
Hate: Garlic.
❤
0 Heart Events: The farmer's first visit to the Woods.
2 heart events: rainy day, 6 in the morning to 12 at noon to come to the Forest.
4 Heart events: sunny days come to Town.
6 Heart events: sunny days, 8 o 'clock to 6 o 'clock in the evening came to Town.
8 Heart events: Arrive at the Beach from 12 p.m. to 6 p.m.
10 Heart events: After receiving your letter from Belos, come into the Forest from 6 to 0 in the evening, sunny days.
14 Heart events: on the 20th of winter, sunny days, come to Town from 8am to 12am.
❤
Hi! I'm firecherno, and this is the first NPC I've ever made, a dog named Belos. Thank you for downloading him! > <
Because it was the first NPC I made, there were a lot of bumps in the middle (...) Fortunately, we've done the whole thing in the end. 178 sentences in total (yes, I was lazy), 7 events, plus 6 CG. But there are a lot of regrets, because the first time not very good at making maps, so Belos does not have a house of his own and usually stayed in the Woods. In addition, the journey is relatively monotonous. Although I am poor at making up stories and shaping people (as well as drawing), Belos is a really good dog and I hope you like him!! T TTTT
I have no problem with the festival coordinates of Belos, but I do not exclude some bugs caused by conflicts with other Custom NPC of your own. If this happens, please change it yourself! In addition, it is recommended to play with the default view of the game. Zooming in or out may affect the viewing of the event experience.
The first time I make an NPC,there  will inevitably have a missing place, if found any bugs tell me, I will try to get rid of (?)
Thanks again, hope you like him ~
（Finally, my English is really poor, and I have been using mechanical translation. I'm really sorry for any inconvenience! T T）
